description: This Java class defines an abstract fragment for input method settings within an Android application, providing a helper for configuring preference categories, titles, icons, and updating subtype enablers.

classes.name: InputMethodSettingsFragment
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for input method configuration fragments, managing preference screen setup and interaction with input method settings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the preference screen and input method settings when the fragment is created.

methods.name: setInputMethodSettingsCategoryTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the input method settings category, either by resource ID or CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the subtype enabler, either by resource ID or CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the subtype enabler, either by resource ID or Drawable.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the subtype enabler when the fragment resumes.
